## [0.31.0] - 2026-09-16

Settings gains a Density control, and two import formats keep more of what they're given.

### Added

- **A Density setting in Settings > Appearance > Interface.** Default is noticeably tighter than before - about a third more rows fit in the same window - and Comfortable keeps the previous, roomier spacing for anyone who prefers it.

### Fixed

- Postman import now creates a client certificate entry (Settings > Network > Client Certificates) from a request-level certificate, when it points at a file Vayu can read, instead of only reporting it as skipped.
- JMeter import now reads a "Files Upload" sampler into a form-data body with its file fields, instead of dropping it.
